notes.title: Endless Invader, The Result of my Life-Defining Challenge
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45684100/42c24646329cad648b5aca6e27d08f59a30929f5.png"]Hello! I'm Emvir, the developer of this game, Endless Invader.


This game began as a dream I committed to ten years ago, and I finally started development three years back.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45684100/0fa53284b7b711f2ae5b7e311d90798119d3d4b1.png"]Every element in Endless Invader was intentionally created by me alone

without the help of generative AI.



It's the result of a challenge I poured my life into.



From here on, I’ll be sharing the behind-the-scenes stories of this passionate journey and connecting with you all.


Please support me with a Wishlist and a Follow!
